acceptance.given: A Replay Result reports success after replay execution of the declared command.

oracle.expected: The structured Replay Result verification output contains a distinct passing command-verification record bound to the declared native command identity, independently of the other verification fields.
forbidden: The successful Replay Result lacks an independent command-verification outcome.
Command verification is inferred only from an aggregate success flag or another verification category.
The command-verification record is bound to a different command identity.
oracle.observable: The replay test/validator output exposes command verification as its own named result with pass status and matching command identity evidence.

acceptance.then: The command is independently verified for the successful Replay Result.
acceptance.when: Run the Toolchain replay test suite against a successful Replay Result and inspect its structured verification output.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Use the existing replay test selector in scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_package_replay.py and construct a successful Replay Result whose command-verification record is absent, aggregate-only, or bound to a different command identity; the validator must reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure every successful Replay Result emits and validates a separate command-verification outcome bound to the declared native command identity, rather than deriving command verification from aggregate success.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing Replay Result schema and successful replay behavior; rollback only the added independent command-verification emission and check if compatibility validation fails.

slice_hint.state_transition: A successful Replay Result transitions from command verification unestablished to command verification independently observed and passed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Replay validation passes only when the successful Replay Result contains a distinct passing command-verification record with the declared native command identity; missing, aggregate-only, or mismatched command verification fails validation.
